data.one_liner: High-performance fuzzy search algorithm with typo tolerance and Porter stemming.
data.what_it_does: Performs fuzzy searching on Dart datasets using Jaro-Winkler distance, Levenshtein distance, and Porter stemming. It supports automatic parallel processing via isolates for large datasets and includes dataset cleaning utilities.
use_when: You need auto-suggestions or search bars with typo tolerance.
You are querying local datasets, offline-first databases, or in-memory state.
You need text stemming and stop-word removal for search queries.
avoid_when: You require a full-text search engine with indexing for massive remote databases.
You need complex relational querying rather than text similarity.
strengths: Built-in typo correction using Levenshtein distance.
Automatic isolate usage for performance with large datasets (>1000 items).
Includes text processing like Porter stemming and dataset cleaners.
weaknesses: Isolates do not work natively on web platforms, requiring manual configuration flags.
In-memory searching may consume significant memory for very large datasets.
